UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Registered TaskFlow user profile with role, approval status, and reward balance.

userId.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the user.

role.description: Role of the user in TaskFlow.

approvalStatus.description: Account approval status managed by admins.

balanceCents.description: Accumulated task reward balance in INR paise (100 paise = ₹1.00, read-only for regular users).

completedTasksCount.description: Total number of approved tasks for this user.

assignedTaskId.description: Optional ID of the primary highlighted task assigned to the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user registered (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Task.title: Task
Task.description: A task created by an admin and visible to authenticated users, with INR reward details, text proof submission, and review status.

title.description: Short descriptive title of the task.

description.description: Detailed instructions and acceptance criteria for the task.

category.description: Task category label (e.g., QA Testing, Content Review, Survey).

rewardCents.description: Reward value in INR paise (100 paise = ₹1.00) upon approval.

assignedUserId.description: UID of the user to whom this task is assigned.

assignedUserName.description: Display name of the assigned user.

status.description: Current workflow status of the task.

proofText.description: Text-only proof submitted by the assigned user.

adminFeedback.description: Optional review feedback provided by an administrator.

createdBy.description: UID of the administrator who created the task.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Submission.title: Submission
Submission.description: Text-only task proof submission stored in the submissions collection.

taskId.description: ID of the task this submission fulfills.

rewardCents.description: Reward value in cents associated with the task.

userId.description: UID of the user submitting the proof.

userName.description: Display name of the submitting user.

proofText.description: Text-only proof submitted by the user.

adminFeedback.description: Optional review note from an administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the submission was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the submission was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores registered user profiles, balances, and account statuses.

/tasks/{taskId}.description: Stores tasks assigned to users along with status and reward information.

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Stores text-only task proof submissions and their review statuses.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores trusted administrator UIDs for role-based access control.
